scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @pixel-wall/server" "npm run dev -w @pixel-wall/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pixel-wall/shared && npm run build -w @pixel-wall/server && npm run build -w @pixel-wall/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pixel-wall/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
